Topic: Purchase requisition concept
Module: MM
Product applicability (pending human review): SAP ERP | 6.0 EHP8 Latest (documentation selector observed; mutable)
Transaction codes: none established
Summary: A purchase requisition communicates an internal procurement need to Purchasing, including quantity and timing. It is not a document sent outside the enterprise and can be fulfilled through purchase orders or longer-term agreements.
Supported diagnostic observations: No procedural runbook established
Prerequisites: Use as a conceptual definition, not a company purchasing policy.
Limitations: Does not specify conversion steps, organizational approval rules, or a complete procurement lifecycle.

Topic: Purchase-order mode switching and permissions
Module: MM
Product applicability (pending human review): SAP ERP | 6.0 EHP6 Latest (documentation selector observed; mutable)
Transaction codes: ME21N, ME22N, ME23N
Summary: The single-screen purchase-order interface supports create, change and display modes. Switching among those modes requires the necessary authorizations; being able to display a document does not establish permission to change it.
Supported diagnostic observations: Distinguish display access from the reported attempt to change or create a document.
Prerequisites: The cited page is for ERP EHP6; do not silently extrapolate its screen behavior to another edition.
Limitations: A permission prerequisite is not a root-cause diagnosis or a prescription to grant a specific authorization.

Topic: Invoice payment blocks and variance evidence
Module: MM
Product applicability (pending human review): SAP S/4HANA on-premise | 2025 FPS01 (Feb 2026; observed selector)
Transaction codes: none established
Summary: An invoice can be blocked for payment manually or automatically. A variance beyond an applicable upper tolerance can permit posting while still blocking payment; payment blocking and inability to post are different symptoms.
Supported diagnostic observations: For an item variance, clarify the difference with the appropriate purchasing, receiving or supplier contact.
Prerequisites: Know whether the reported problem is posting failure or payment blocking; tolerance values depend on configuration.
Limitations: No universal tolerance value or instruction to raise limits, remove a block, or bypass approval is supplied.

Topic: Requisitions versus orders in procurement commitments
Module: MM
Product applicability (pending human review): SAP ERP | 6.0 EHP8 Latest (documentation selector observed; mutable)
Transaction codes: none established
Summary: In the procurement-commitment discussion, requisitions describe internal requirements, whereas purchase orders request supply from a vendor under agreed conditions. These are different procurement objects, not interchangeable document names.
Supported diagnostic observations: No procedural runbook established
Prerequisites: Read together with the requisition definition and keep the commitment-accounting context explicit.
Limitations: Not a legal interpretation of contracts, full purchase-order definition or complete procure-to-pay guide.
